module origen_126398 (
    input A1,
    input A2,
    input A3,
    input B1,
    input C1,
    output Y
);

    wire or0_out, nand0_out;

    or0 or0_inst (
        .A(A1),
        .B(A2),
        .C(A3),
        .X(or0_out)
    );

    nand0 nand0_inst (
        .A(or0_out),
        .B(B1),
        .C(C1),
        .Y(nand0_out)
    );

    buf0 buf0_inst (
        .A(nand0_out),
        .X(Y)
    );

endmodule

module or0 (
    input A,
    input B,
    input C,
    output X
);

    assign X = A | B | C;

endmodule

module nand0 (
    input A,
    input B,
    input C,
    output Y
);

    assign Y = ~(A & B & C);

endmodule

module buf0 (
    input A,
    output X
);

    assign X = A;

endmodule

Complete the module

InputThe generated Stage 1 text plus masked module rtl: stage2_template/design.v. Required top module: origen_126398.
InstructionRestore the masked expression in design.v using the specification and retained RTL context. Return the complete corrected RTL with the same top module. Only the default configuration is scored.

Stored wording: stage2_template/TASK.md

OutputComplete RTL module with the masked logic restored.
